faq.question: Is a Bachelor’s in Information Technology available in Mauritius?
faq.answer: Yes. Middlesex University Mauritius lists a BSc (Hons) Information Technology with a three-year, full-time duration for the September 2026 intake.

faq.question: Which master’s degrees related to IT are available in Mauritius?
faq.answer: Related options include the MSc Information Technology (Conversion) and MSc Applied Computing and Digital Technologies at the Open University of Mauritius. The University of Mauritius also lists MSc Artificial Intelligence and MSc Software Project Management.

faq.question: What are the tuition fees for international students?
faq.answer: Published examples include £6,400 for Middlesex University Mauritius’s BSc Information Technology and US\$5,620 for the Open University of Mauritius’s MSc Applied Computing and Digital Technologies. Information Technology Fees in Mauritius can change, so confirm the current amount before applying.

faq.question: What is the estimated cost of living in Mauritius?
faq.answer: A preliminary budget is MUR 15,000–25,000 per month, approximately ₹30,000–₹50,000 using the illustrative exchange rate in this article. Actual costs depend on accommodation, transport and lifestyle.

faq.question: What jobs can I pursue after studying Information Technology?
faq.answer: Depending on your specialisation and experience, you may explore software development, IT support, network administration, cybersecurity, cloud computing, data analysis or IT consulting. Practical projects and internships can strengthen your career prospects.
